description: Address 4 issues from v2 semantic review: error message leaks, PDF download auth, stored XSS via HTML fallback, and test coverage for critical paths.
steps: Fix error message leak in regenerate_section and SSE error handler in reports.py
Fix PDF download link to use fetch with auth header in frontend page.tsx
Add HTML sanitization in renderer.py to prevent stored XSS
Add test coverage for critical paths in test_reports.py, test_report_planner.py, test_report_renderer.py
acceptance_criteria: regenerate_section returns generic error message, logs full exception
SSE error handler returns generic error message, logs full exception
Frontend PDF download uses fetch with Authorization header
renderer.py sanitizes HTML output to remove script/iframe/object/embed tags and on* attributes
New tests cover: start with no outline (400), start wrong status (409), download with no file (404), regenerate bad section (404), invalid template_id, sanitize script tags, sanitize event handlers
All tests pass, ruff lint passes, pnpm build succeeds
verification: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -v
findings: All 4 v2 review issues addressed. 127 total tests pass (11 new). Ruff lint passes. Frontend builds successfully. The _sanitize_html function is regex-based to avoid adding a new dependency. PDF download now uses fetch with Bearer token from localStorage.
